sanskrit_verse:
प्रकाशघातका ये तु तथा चोपांशुघातकाः ।
ज्ञात्वा सम्यग्धनं हृत्वा हन्तव्याः विविधैर् वधैः ॥
transliteration: prakāśaghātakā ye tu tathā copāṃśughātakāḥ | jñātvā samyagdhanaṃ hṛtvā hantavyāḥ vividhair vadhaiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who knowingly obstruct illumination and also secretly harm others—having seized rightful wealth—must be removed through appropriate completion processes.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from conscious integrity, not force
Causation is determined by disruption of dharma-flow
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to awareness and intent
Restoration logic requires removal of obstruction before reintegration
Consciousness alignment mandates purification of motive fields
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor knowingly obstructs enlightenment THEN initiate capacity-restoration protocol
IF actor seizes legitimate resources AND causes hidden harm THEN trigger sequential dissolution process
IF violation disrupts dharma-field THEN execute non-punitive removal via completion mechanics
IF intent involves concealment THEN apply consciousness-realignment sequence prior to reintegration
IF damage affects collective illumination THEN invoke supra-individual restoration framework
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, the threshold for responsibility lies in demonstrable knowledge of harm caused to dharma-field. Authority resides in restoring alignment rather than enforcing punitive measures. The court must ensure that violators undergo purification sequences before eligibility for societal reintegration is assessed.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal link between obstruction of light and collapse of dharma-field. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential misalignment leading to systemic decay. Responsibility is calibrated against the degree of conscious interference with truth-processes. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction occurs through completion, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate dharmic detoxification to clear obstructive imprints
Engage sequential dissolution of concealed motives
Execute energetic retrieval of displaced wealth back to its lawful field
Apply prakāśa-saṃskāra to restore luminous clarity within perpetrator
Conduct śuddhi-yajña to reintegrate purified entity into dharma-circuit
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Justice executed solely for restoration, consciousness realignment, and reintegration. Reality affirmed as non-punitive. All judgments arise from and return to pure consciousness.
